name: Prakruti Resort Kashid
why_special: Senior beach-front resort 200 m from Kashid beach — 40 cottage rooms across landscaped grounds, outdoor pool, multi-cuisine restaurant with Konkani thali. The longest-running Kashid resort and the consistent Mumbai weekend pick.

name: Kashid Beach Resort by RDB Hospitality
why_special: Direct beach-walkout resort with 35 rooms — outdoor pool, beach barbecue, multi-cuisine Konkani restaurant. The newer alternative to Prakruti with the strongest direct-beach access in Kashid.
